notes: Focused Java public-API evidence for IEEE 1516.1-2025 §12.12.4.2. For fixed arrays, variable arrays, fixed records, variant records, and extendable variant records, the scenario encodes into a shared ByteWrapper after a prefix octet, decodes from that position into an empty receiver, checks the encoded value and cursor boundary, and decodes the following HLAoctet. This covers Java DataElement encode(ByteWrapper)/decode(ByteWrapper); it does not claim C++ encodeInto/decodeFrom, C++ pointer ownership, exact Annex C behavior, or conformance.
